stances.quote: I will say it is funny watching OpenAI boast about solving a complex math problem using millions of dollars of compute (and someone else’s work) all while remaining unable to solve the most obvious math problem (how to make their services profitable)

stances.summary: Criticizes OpenAI and Anthropic for dedicating resources to brute-force GPU hacking
stances.quote:
Brute-force hacking using GPUs has existed for over a decade, albeit using different techniques. The "innovation" here is that we actually dedicated resources *from two companies that raised $217bn this year* to, in no uncertain terms, find better ways to do it.

stances.summary: Reframes AI hacking threat as compute-intensive brute force, not autonomous agents
stances.quote:
As I went into with Cal Newport, this is not "autonomous hacking" by "agents that escape sandboxes," it's Anthropic and OpenAI throwing unlimited compute to make LLMs that can "do cybersecurity" and having really terrible security practices.  
www.youtube.com/watch?v=RoIj...

stances.summary: Identifies real LLM threat: companies using billions in compute for brute-force hacking
stances.quote: To be clear, there is an actual threat from LLMs: Anthropic and OpenAI using hundreds of billions of dollars' worth of infrastructure provided by the largest companies in the world to brute-force hacking using LLMs bouncing off of each other because they can't find any other use

stances.summary: Criticizes AI industry leaders for ignoring present harms while justifying future risk
stances.quote: it's unclear whether this is a rationalist-poisoned guy or just a deeply cynical valley guy but if you truly think this is what you and your peers are doing this is a very strange way to act. It also, as ever, doesn't deal with the actual harms happening today

AI* has a >10%** chance to kill us all

stances.quote:
Here’s this week’s Better Offline. I walk you through how society continues to manage rather than deal with crises, and how the AI bubble is yet another crisis resulting from a failure to deal with the complexity of the real world.

stances.summary: AI bubble will collapse when venture funding dries up, exposing market concentration dangers
stances.quote:
The AI bubble will survive right until it doesn't - and that moment will be when the money stops flowing, and the dangers posed by this circular dealing and market concentration are exposed.

stances.summary: Chip sales artificially inflated by AI labs' compute spending, masking weak underlying demand
stances.quote:
While Broadcom and NVIDIA talk a big game about "demand for AI," their chip sales are really a proxy for OpenAI and Anthropic's compute, who are used to pump up the backlogs of neoclouds with contracts they can't afford to create an illusion of AI demand.
www.wheresyoured.at/conc

stances.summary: Criticizes mainstream media for protecting power structures and repeating official narratives
stances.quote: Sadly there are large parts of the mainstream media that will coalesce to protect the system and repeat whatever the powerful says as gospel, and the only way to stop this from happening is to actually call them out by name again and again

stances.summary: Media failed to scrutinize AI, now seeking to cover consequences
stances.quote:
Though the media largely failed to scrutinize generative AI during its ascent, it now smells blood and is ready to pounce. The problem is, asking whether we're in an AI bubble doesn't really matter if we don't discuss the consequences.

www.wheresyoured.at/the-ai-hater...
